blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Starting Monday, Nov. 16, all government offices in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) will drop the four-day compressed workweek and go back to the regular five-day schedule. The change was agreed on during the first regular Cabinet meeting of the Bangsamoro Government on Nov. 6. The Office of the Chief Minister put it into effect through Memorandum Circular No. 0150, issued in Nov. 10. The circular lifts and revokes Memorandum Circular No. 0049, Series of 2026, which had set up the four-day onsite work arrangement and compressed workweek.
